lmstudio._comment_server: The LM Studio desktop app must have its local server running (Developer -> Local Server, or `lms server start`). An open app alone is not enough.
lmstudio._comment_models: Pin a model id per stage so runs are reproducible. Leave a stage out to fall back to whichever chat model is loaded. Scout is a cheap classification pass; chart is the expensive one.

github._comment_token: Set GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment to raise the unauthenticated rate limit from 60 to 5000 requests per hour.

scout._comment_stages: Stages batch and do not interleave: runtime.json allows one resident task model, so the 4B scout pass and the 14B deep dive must run as separate commands.
scout._comment_models: Leave blank to use whatever LM Studio has loaded. Pin these to match config/runtime.json model_routes for reproducible runs.
scout._comment_weights: Ranking is deterministic arithmetic over these weights. Change them and re-run `python -m scout rank`; every component score is stored in scout_signal so any position can be explained.
scout._comment_escalation: Hosted escalation is opt-in and keyed from the environment only (OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Set provider to openai or anthropic to enable.
scout._comment_toolchain: Stage 5 delegates to the ToolSet: shallow clone, run_guided_repository_investigation, read the slice as evidence, delete the clone. The slice is never retained - a slice is a component of a source, not a source.

license_overrides._comment: Manually verified licences for repositories GitHub reports as NOASSERTION or Other. The build prefers these over the API. Verified by reading the LICENSE file; record the date and who checked.

hashicorp/terraform.note: Business Source License 1.1 - source-available, not OSI open source

getsentry/sentry.note: Functional Source License (fair source) - not OSI open source

animate-css/animate.css.note: Hippocratic License - ethical-use restrictions, not OSI open source

catalogue._comment: The read surface, the derived index and Mode D. Markdown is truth; everything in catalogue_index.sqlite is rebuildable from the vault.
catalogue._comment_embeddings: Optional. Absent LM Studio the consult surface degrades to filters + FTS5 and says so; it never fails. The model id carries LM Studio's quantisation suffix, and a bare family name is resolved against the loaded models.
catalogue._comment_graph: graphify has two permitted uses and no others (Design Specification 4B). Absent, the vault graph degrades to no communities; centrality is computed here either way.
catalogue._comment_toolchain: Probed in order; the first with local_tool_assist_mcp wins, so moving the ToolSet needs no code change.
catalogue._comment_workbench: Mode D only, person-initiated. --network none, capped memory and CPU, non-root, no inherited environment.

usage._comment_posture: How this catalogue's output will be used, which is the only thing that makes a licence class consequential. 'private' - the library serves one person's R&D on tooling that is not published, so no distribution obligation is ever triggered and every source is usable as a reference and as a tool; licence becomes a mild preference for keeping future options open rather than a filter. 'distributed' - output may end up in something published, so copyleft obligations bind and an unrecorded licence is no grant at all. Read by scout.rank.reusability and librarian.config.permitted_uses. Licence facts are recorded identically under both; only what is done with them changes.
usage._comment_change: Set to 'distributed' before any of this is published, and re-read 00-Indexes/Licence Resolution 2026-09-03.md, which lists what a person still has to confirm.
usage._comment_role: What the catalogue is for, which decides what a property costs a candidate. 'reference' - it locates and describes prior work so a person can find it, read it and decide what to do with it; age, popularity and licence are facts to report, never grounds for hiding a source. 'integration' - it selects components to depend on, where staleness and obscurity genuinely predict risk. Read by scout.rank.vitality and scout.rank.adoption. See LOCATE_DO_NOT_ADJUDICATE in the Design Specification.

_comment_paths: Machine-specific paths live here and never in package defaults. A checkout elsewhere overrides them or omits them, and the affected subsystem degrades with a named reason rather than failing.
